Classes module

School Management System - Classes Module

This module defines the core data models used in the School Management System:

  • Person

  • Student

  • Instructor

  • Courses

These classes enforce validation (age, email), maintain relationships between students, instructors, and courses, and provide helper methods for registration and assignment.
